messages:
Arjun: quick q — as we cut over v6, what do we want as the rollback safety net?
Sophia: we need an escape hatch beyond feature flags. circuit breaker + routing fallback?
Nina (SRE): +1 on circuit breaker. also need kill-switch for the sidecar adapters.
Mike: can we rely on header sniffing to route old clients to v5 automatically?
Arjun: header sniffing ok, but edge cases with proxies. prefer server-side capability gate + tenant opt-in.
Jessica: ops-wise: want a backfill job that rewrites tenant config to opt-out if errors spike, not manual.
Kyle: suggestion: phased rollout with shadow traffic, then soft-redirect when latency < 200ms and error < 0.5%
Nina (SRE): add automated rollback triggers: 5xx rate > 1% for 5m OR p95 latency > 750ms for 3m -> rollback.
Arjun: agree. define rollback as: flip routing back to v5 + disable new handler + alert on pager duty
deploy-bot: deploy triggered: v6-cutover/canary-2 -> 2025-11-10T14:03Z :shipit:
Mike: need telemetry namespacing: metric names must include "target_version" tag so we can compare
Sophia: also expose a /admin/rollback endpoint guarded by MFA + audit log. example:
```bash
curl -X POST https://admin.redwood-inference.internal/rollback \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"target":"v5","reason":"canary-failure"}'
```
Jessica: ops checklist item: run a synthetic workload hitting long-tail sequences before cutover
Kyle: flagging: document migration runbook, include tenant communication template and fallback timings
Arjun: I'll draft the RFC follow-up with concrete thresholds and add to runbook. thanks all :thumbsup:
